title: Hawaii Five-0
description:
S07 E16 — Poniu I Ke Aloha
While McGarrett and Danno celebrate Valentine's Day with their girlfriends, the Five-0 team investigates the murder of a man taking a class on how to meet women.

title: Hawaii Five-0
description:
S07 E17 — Hahai I Na Pilikua Nui
The Five-0 must once again engage in the twisted mind games of serial killer Dr. Madison Gray when she arrives at the HPD covered in blood that matches Alicia Brown's.

title: Hawaii Five-0
description:
S07 E18 — E Malama Pono
After tracking down the missing uranium, which has been used to build a bomb in the middle of the jungle, McGarrett and Danny must move the explosive material through treacherous terrain before it detonates.

title: Hawaii Five-0
description:
S07 E19 — Puka 'Ana
McGarrett and Kono suspect that an abused young girl may be the victim of a sex trafficking ring on the Island; Chin and Grover investigate a murder at a sober living facility.

title: Hawaii Five-0
description:
S07 E20 — Huikau Nā Makau a na Lawai'a
The Five-0 helps a private investigator in the case of a kidnapped woman whose husband may have something to hide; Rachel tells Danny that she is getting a divorce from Stan.

title: Hawaii Five-0
description:
S07 E21 — Ua Malo'o Ka Wai
McGarrett and the Five-0 are captured while tracking a dangerous nemesis to the island of Lanai; Grover takes his son to Chicago, where he testifies against a dirty cop.

title: Hawaii Five-0
description:
S07 E22 — Waimaka 'Ele'Ele
McGarrett works the murder case of one of the last survivors of the USS Arizona; Adam uncovers bone fragments at his new construction job.

title: Hawaii Five-0
description:
S07 E23 — Wehe 'ana
Danny protects a coma patient who was the key witness from his last case at the Hawaiian Police Department.

title: Hawaii Five-0
description:
S07 E24 — He Ke'u Na Ka 'Alae a Hina
McGarrett gets a tip that someone is plotting a terror attack on Oahu; Chin and Abby face a difficult decision.

title: Hawaii Five-0
description:
S09 E01 — Ka 'Owili 'Oka'i
After McGarrett's CIA agent friend is killed, he lets himself be captured by the group he thinks is responsible to find the killer; Tani questions whether she should tell McGarrett about the murder weapon she found at Adam's house.

title: Hawaii Five-0
description:
S09 E02 — Ke Kanaka I Ha'ule Mai Ka Lewa Mai
When a vacationing father on a flight to Honolulu is kidnapped and forced to parachute midflight, Danny, Tani and Junior track him through the jungle to discover that he may not be who he seems; McGarrett is threatened with a secret from his past.

title: Hawaii Five-0
description:
S09 E03 — Mimiki Ke Kai, Ahuwale Ka Papa Leho
A heat wave hits Oahu, contributing to a spike in crime; McGarrett and Danny hunt down a bank thief; Tani and Junior's car is stolen while they're on duty; Kamekona incites a riot by price-gouging his ice.

title: Hawaii Five-0
description:
S09 E04 — A'ohe Kio Pohaku Nalo i Ke Alo Pali
Jerry accompanies Junior as he escorts a fallen soldier home to Oahu; McGarrett and Danny discover a body when they delve into the highly profitable black market for sand.

title: The Listener
description:
S03 E10 — Lockdown
Toby and the IIB must find the source of a deadly virus before it kills more people.

title: The Listener
description:
S03 E11 — Captain Nightfall
Violent home invasions are being interrupted by a citizen dressed as a superhero.

title: The Listener
description:
S03 E12 — The Bro Code
Oz puts his life in danger after asking Toby to help an old friend who witnessed a murder.

title: The Listener
description:
S03 E13 — The Shooting
The team must prove Michelle was set up after a suspect is shot.

title: NCIS: New Orleans
description:
S01 E20 — Rock-a-Bye-Baby
When a Navy commander's car is stolen with his baby inside, the team must determine if it was a targeted abduction.

title: NCIS: New Orleans
description:
S01 E21 — You'll Do
LaSalle's brother, Cade, needs the team's help when he becomes a murder suspect -- and cannot remember what happened; LaSalle is determined to prove Cade's innocence, despite the wealth of evidence against him.

title: NCIS: New Orleans
description:
S01 E22 — How Much Pain Can You Take?
Baitfish murders a person close to the team in order to send a message to Pride; a citywide hunt for the elusive criminal takes place.

title: NCIS: New Orleans
description:
S01 E23 — My City
Pride has suspicions about a mole; new intelligence comes to light that indicates a breach at the ports.

title: NCIS: New Orleans
description:
S02 E01 — Sic Semper Tyranis
Pride and the team must go on a dangerous undercover mission to retrieve a stolen missile and prevent an attack.

title: NCIS: New Orleans
description:
S02 E02 — Shadow Unit
A blogger dedicated to exposing government corruption is murdered; during the investigation, it is revealed that a war crime may have occurred during a humanitarian effort in Bolivia.

title: NCIS: New Orleans
description:
S02 E03 — Touched by the Sun
When a highly regarded Navy pilot is killed after crashing a new, high-tech jet at an air show, the team must determine if it was human or mechanical error.

title: NCIS: New Orleans
description:
S02 E04 — I Do
The NCIS team investigates when a Navy drone pilot is murdered after using a black market drone to obtain military surveillance.

title: NCIS: New Orleans
description:
S02 E05 — Foreign Affairs
When an Australian Royal Navy Lieutenant is murdered in New Orleans, Special Agent Naomi Parsons (Kate Beahan) is sent to work with Special Agent Pride.

title: NCIS: New Orleans
description:
S02 E06 — Insane in the Membrane
When a petty officer is found dead, the team's participation in the annual Red Dress Run comes to a halt.

title: NCIS: New Orleans
description:
S02 E07 — Broken Hearted
An extremely intelligent Navy coder -- employed by Brody's mom (Annie Potts) -- is put in danger when the heart intended for him is stolen.

title: NCIS: New Orleans
description:
S02 E08 — Confluence
After traveling to Texas to escort a key witness to the trial of an infamous arms dealer, Sonja and Special Agent Pride are ambushed.

title: NCIS: New Orleans
description:
S02 E09 — Darkest Hour
During a blackout in New Orleans, Pride is determined to figure out who murdered a family friend's fiancé.

title: NCIS: New Orleans
description:
S02 E10 — Billy and the Kid
A Marine's murder reveals new clues in the first case LaSalle and Pride worked together; a Thanksgiving celebration at Pride's bar.

title: NCIS: New Orleans
description:
S02 E11 — Blue Christmas
Wade's adopted son becomes a suspect after a series of Christmas burglaries turn deadly; Brody and LaSalle tease Sonja about the team's holiday gift exchange.

title: NCIS: New Orleans
description:
S02 E12 — Sister City: Part Two
Special Agent Pride and the team investigate a Russian sleeper agent involved with Abby's brother; Sebastian goes to Washington, D.C., to work with Abby; Bishop drives all night to deliver a package and help the New Orleans team.

title: NCIS: New Orleans
description:
S02 E13 — Undocumented
The staged suicide of a petty officer turns out to be murder; the team secretly works on an online dating profile for Pride.

title: NCIS: New Orleans
description:
S02 E14 — Father's Day
A Mardi Gras celebration at Pride's bar is cut short when he and Mayor Douglas Hamilton (Steven Weber) are abducted by unknown assailants.

title: NCIS: New Orleans
description:
S02 E15 — No Man's Land
Evidence suggests that the man responsible for saving a lieutenant's life is a soldier who was captured in Afghanistan.

title: NCIS: New Orleans
description:
S02 E16 — Second Chances
Special Agent Pride and the team uncover a domestic drug ring -- led by Sonja's childhood friend, Marion Watkins (Samaire Armstrong), that is producing cocaine.

title: FBI: Most Wanted
description:
S03 E09 — Run-Hide-Fight
While holiday shopping, Barnes and Jess are caught in the middle of a mall shooting; Gaines, Hana and Ortiz try to help from the outside, knowing their team's family members are inside and at risk.

title: Bull
description:
S01 E07 — Never Saw the Sign
While assisting a man facing vehicular manslaughter charges, Bull finds a connection between the case and a state assemblyman who would benefit from a guilty verdict; Danny and Cable investigate why Marissa is acting and dressing differently.

title: Bull
description:
S01 E08 — Too Perfect
Bull attempts to assist his ex-wife's defense in a wrongful death lawsuit, but he's hindered by unresolved conflicts from their marriage and a longstanding rift with her brother.

title: Bull
description:
S01 E09 — Light My Fire
Bull faces his past when he returns to his childhood home to help with the defense of a young man accused of arson.

title: Hawaii Five-0
description:
S06 E04 — Ka Papahana Holo Pono
A wealthy recluse's corpse is found in a field with almost $1 million in counterfeit bills; Adam is abducted and forced to torture one of Gabriel's men.

title: Hawaii Five-0
description:
S06 E05 — Ka 'alapahi Nui
The team questions members of a stunt biker gang when a killer escapes by jumping his motorcycle from roof to roof; the team prepares for Tough Mudder.

title: Hawaii Five-0
description:
S06 E06 — Na Pilikua Nui
On Halloween, the team tracks a serial killer inspired by an iconic character; a blood bank is raided by an armed gang.

title: Hawaii Five-0
description:
S06 E07 — Na Kama Hele
McGarrett and Lynn's date on a deserted island turns deadly when a mob boss gets involved; a gambler abducts a high-school football star's father in hopes of forcing the athlete to throw a game.

title: Hawaii Five-0
description:
S06 E08 — Piko Pau 'iole
A charming con man (Kristoffer Polaha) helps Five-0 look for the person who murdered his partner; a police inspector from San Francisco (Julie Benz) works with Chin on an investigation involving the murders of five arms dealers.

title: Hawaii Five-0
description:
S06 E09 — Hana Keaka
When a college professor is killed, Five-0 goes back to school with Danny, who is posing as the professor's replacement.

title: Hawaii Five-0
description:
S06 E10 — Ka Makau Kaa Kaua
When a promising local boxer's brother is murdered, the prime suspect is an outspoken opponent -- the reigning champion.

title: Hawaii Five-0
description:
S06 E11 — Kuleana
Danny and McGarrett try to solve their partnership issues with a couples retreat in Maui; Kamekona's past comes back to haunt him.

title: Hawaii Five-0
description:
S06 E12 — Ua ola loko i ke aloha
A special personal mission sends McGarrett's Aunt Deb (Carol Burnett) to Oahu; unstable Japanese WWII bombs hidden on the island are stolen.

title: Hawaii Five-0
description:
S06 E13 — Umia Ka Hanu
Grover goes to Chicago to get a confession from Clay Maxwell; Chin and Kono are held at gunpoint by people who don't know they are cops.

title: Hawaii Five-0
description:
S06 E14 — Hoa 'inea
A double homicide occurs that involves infidelity; McGarrett and the team share disastrous Valentine's Day experiences.

title: Hawaii Five-0
description:
S06 E15 — Ke Koa Lokomaika'i
Danny's mom is questioned by the FBI; McGarrett works with a young, autistic man who might be able to help solve a murder.

title: Hawaii Five-0
description:
S06 E16 — Ka Pohaku Kihi Pa'a
McGarrett turns to Odell Martin (Michael Imperioli) for help when a confidential informant is accused of murder.

title: Hawaii Five-0
description:
S06 E17 — Waiwai
A Russian spy steals a flash drive containing classified information that puts a Five-0 member at risk; McGarrett learns why Catherine left; Abby keeps her mission a secret.

title: Hawaii Five-0
description:
S06 E18 — Kanaka Hahai
The body of a man left for dead off the coast of Oahu leads Five-0 to a deadly slave trade business that is operating aboard a fishing vessel.

title: Hawaii Five-0
description:
S06 E19 — Malama Ka Po'e
Grover is forced to take his family on the run when a dangerous mob boss seeks revenge for a 15-year-old case.

title: Hawaii Five-0
description:
S06 E20 — Ka Haunaele
The team investigates the theft of high-tech indestructible suits made for the military; Jerry and his sister try to save a captive elephant.

title: Hawaii Five-0
description:
S06 E21 — Ka Pono Ku'oko'a
When a deliberate chemical spill enables six dangerous inmates to escape, the team goes on an intensive manhunt to find them.

title: Hawaii Five-0
description:
S06 E22 — I'Ike Ke Ao
The team races to save an abducted college student from a dangerous vigilante; Max, Kamekona and Flippa struggle to survive after being shipwrecked.

title: Hawaii Five-0
description:
S06 E23 — Pilina Koko
The Five-0 team learns that one of its own has a deep connection to the young daughter of a woman who was murdered in her home.

title: FBI: Most Wanted
description:
S03 E10 — Incendiary
The team hunts for a young man who is using napalm-style bombs to attack his targets; with Tali away, Jess and Sarah begin to adjust to their empty nest.

title: MacGyver
description:
S03 E14 — Father + Bride + Betrayal
An international crime boss offers to surrender if he's allowed to return to the United States to watch his daughter walk down the aisle; MacGyver and the team crash the wedding to ensure the crime lord doesn't run.

title: MacGyver
description:
S03 E15 — K9 + Smugglers + New Recruit
After a surprising introduction to Phoenix's newest recruit, Desi, MacGyver and team are assigned to protect a gun-sniffing dog who has a bounty on its head.

title: MacGyver
description:
S03 E16 — Lidar + Rogues + Duty
The Phoenix must recover the body of a pilot whose plane crashed while testing an experimental laser mapping system that MacGyver designed; Riley tries to identify the hacker who tricked a SWAT team into arresting her and Elwood.

title: MacGyver
description:
S03 E17 — Seeds + Permafrost + Feather
MacGyver and the team are asked to solve a locked-door mystery when a man working inside a remote, ultra-secure international seed vault disappears.

title: MacGyver
description:
S03 E18 — Murdoc + Helman + Hit
When Nicholas Helman resurfaces to carry out a killing spree, the team is forced to get help from the one person who knows him best -- his protégé, Murdoc.

title: MacGyver
description:
S03 E19 — Friends + Enemies + Border
MacGyver and Desi help a group of Syrian refugees who are being pursued by human traffickers; Bozer is trapped in Oversight's car, and it's rigged to explode.

title: MacGyver
description:
S03 E20 — No-Go + High-Voltage + Rescue
Two American tourists go missing while doing a scavenger hunt through some of the world's most dangerous countries; the Phoenix team goes undercover as backpackers to find them and bring them home alive.

title: Criminal Minds
description:
S13 E11 — Full-Tilt Boogie
The BAU team's investigation into the home invasion and attempted homicide of a police chief's wife uncovers a world of secrets in a small town in Virginia.

title: Criminal Minds
description:
S13 E12 — Bad moon on the Rise
The BAU is called to New York when several casualties of a brutal nature are reported in Central Park.

title: Criminal Minds
description:
S13 E13 — Cure
The BAU is called to investigate a series of homicides in which cryptic messages are found inside the mouths of the victims.

title: Criminal Minds
description:
S13 E14 — Miasma
The BAU is called when the New Orleans Police Department discovers a mass grave inside a vandalized above-ground crypt in a local cemetery.

title: Criminal Minds
description:
S13 E15 — Annihilator
The FBI's assistant director of national security joins the BAU as it investigates the quadruple homicide of a group of roommates in St. Louis.

title: Criminal Minds
description:
S13 E16 — Last Gasp
The BAU meets in secret to investigate a subject who appears to be kidnapping and photographing young women.

title: Criminal Minds
description:
S13 E17 — The Capilanos
The BAU is called to Oklahoma to investigate a murderous clown who is terrorizing a town.

title: Criminal Minds
description:
S13 E18 — The Dance of Love
The BAU travels to Chicago to investigate a case where red roses are left on victims; Rossi gets an unexpected visit from his ex-wife.

title: Criminal Minds
description:
S13 E19 — Ex Parte
The BAU takes charge of a hostage situation at a law firm where Matt Simmons' wife works.

title: Criminal Minds
description:
S13 E20 — All You Can Eat
The BAU is called upon when bioterrorism is suspected in a series of mysterious deaths; Garcia visits her stepbrother to take care of a difficult family issue.

title: Criminal Minds
description:
S13 E21 — Mixed Signals
The BAU is called to Taos, N.M., when someone targets victims' temporal lobes.

title: Criminal Minds
description:
S13 E22 — Believer
The team questions the credibility of a former FBI agent's bizarre account.

title: Criminal Minds
description:
S14 E01 — 300
When Reid and Garcia are abducted by a mass murderer, it's up to the rest of the team to find them; the BAU looks to their past to solve why the two heroes have been targeted.

title: Criminal Minds
description:
S14 E02 — Starter Home
The team tracks a serial killer when remains of numerous victims are found in the walls of an elderly couple's home; the hunt becomes urgent after the BAU learns the killer's specific ritual of when to strike; Rossi reconnects with his ex-wife.

title: Criminal Minds
description:
S14 E03 — Rule 34
Packages with gruesome contents are delivered to six people in the Washington, D.C. area; Simmons and Kristy struggle to connect with their son, David, who is suspended from school for aggressive behavior.

title: Criminal Minds
description:
S14 E04 — Innocence
Soon after the BAU steps in to help local law enforcement isolate a suspect for a murder, a second person who is related to the first victim is killed under similar circumstances; Prentiss is concerned about Garcia's behavior.
